ITEM 1 | Dark reddish-brown, glossy, smooth-skinned oval pieces roughly 2.5-3 cm long, six pieces clustered in the upper right of the plate, whole and unpeeled with slight wrinkling, firm-looking and not juicy; sitting directly on the plate surface | 60
ITEM 2 | Pale off-white, moist-looking, chunky crumbly mass with flaky, shredded texture and small bits of lighter and greenish-tinged pieces, piled in an irregular heap about 8 x 6 cm and roughly 1.5-2 cm high in the lower right of the plate, with no visible browning or crust | 90
